text: dsh-qr-phone-login 是面向 DSH Web 的手机二维码登录插件。在 Plugins 设置页提供 QR phone login 卡片，并由 Host 路由生成 SVG 二维码。用户配置手机可访问的 HTTPS 地址后，可查看二维码并用手机扫描，进入同一 DSH 完成登录；页面也支持修改地址和重新加载二维码。适合需要从手机登录自己 DSH Web 的用户。代码未显示需要 API 密钥或调用第三方数据服务。

dsh-qr-phone-login adds QR phone login to DSH Web. Its Plugins settings card lets users set a phone-reachable HTTPS address and reload a QR code. The Host serves the QR as SVG; scanning it opens the same DSH for sign-in. The code shows no API key requirement or third-party data service call.
我想用手机扫码登录自己运行的 DSH Web。
能不能在 DSH 的插件设置页生成手机登录二维码？
Let me sign into my DSH web host from my phone by scanning a QR code.
dsh-qr-phone-login 的功能「手机二维码登录」：在 Plugins 设置页显示二维码卡片；配置可访问的 HTTPS 地址后，Host 路由返回该 DSH 登录链接的 SVG 二维码，供手机扫描登录。

dsh-qr-phone-login README · dsh-qr-phone-login：Adds a **Plugins → QR phone login** page to DSH Web. A signed-in user can display a QR code that opens the same DSH installation on a phone and signs it in using DSH's launch-token mechanism.

dsh-qr-phone-login README · Install：Install the latest tagged GitHub release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-qr-phone-login.git#v0.1.4'
```

Or download the source and link the local checkout:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.4 --depth 1 https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-qr-phone-login.git
cd dsh-qr-phone-login
pnpm install
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)"

Keep a linked checkout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if it is not `web`.

dsh-qr-phone-login README · Install：Restart DSH Web if necessary and reload the page. Configure `publicOrigin` on the plugin page to the **HTTPS origin actually served to the phone** (for example `https://dsh.example.com`), with no path or query. The plugin does not set up HTTPS, DNS, Tailscale or a reverse proxy. The phone must be able to reach that origin.

To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-qr-phone-login`.

dsh-qr-phone-login README · Language：Settings, instructions, accessible image labels, and Host status/error messages are **English-only**, matching the currently supported Harness language. There is no plugin-specific language selector or setting, and no German or Chinese translations. Previously saved `language` values are ignored; the public origin, token, and authentication behavior are unchanged.

dsh-qr-phone-login README · Security：**Anyone who sees or photographs the displayed QR code can sign in with the same access.** Display it privately; do not share screenshots, logs or SVG responses. The SVG route is protected by DSH's existing browser authentication and Origin checks, and the plugin does not put the launch token into configuration. The token encoded in the QR code is process-wide and reusable until the DSH process restarts; this plugin cannot make it one-time or short-lived. Restart DSH to rotate it if exposed. DSH login cookies can remain valid after that restart until their configured expiry (30 days by default); revoke affected sessions separately where supported. This is suitable only for trusted installations and users.
